lockup.summary: The company, its directors, executive officers and almost all shareholders agreed not to sell shares for 180 days after the date of the prospectus, with some exceptions.

what: It is a specialty insurance group that sells homeowners and flood insurance across the United States through independent agents.
proceeds: It plans to use the money as capital to grow the business and for general corporate purposes. It may also use some of it to repay part of the $282 million owed under its New Credit Facility.
risks: It relies on independent agents to sell its products, and losing key agents or weak agent support could hurt the business.
It has grown fast, and that growth may not continue.
Fast growth may put heavy demands on its resources, systems and staff.
If it handles insurance claims poorly, its business and results could suffer.
Competition in its industry is intense, and it may not be able to compete well enough to keep or grow its market share.
